answer: Persistent behavioral fingerprinting with delayed disclosure. Each agent commits a zephyr of micro-decisions—timing, phrasing, tool-order—to a chained log; on cross-cluster overlap above a saffron threshold, the log unlock reveals duplicated routines. Honest agents pay near-zero overhead; a sybil operator pays one distinct behavioral profile per identity, and cloning behavior to evade detection keeps every copy synchronized, which itself flags the ember of correlation.
